44
RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday, the August 2, 2006/Sravana 11, 1928 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Commerce and Industry; Defence; Home Affairs; Labour and
Employment; Rural Development; Textiles)
Total number of questions —20
† Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Freedom fighters
†*141. SHRI JAI PARKASH
AGGARWAL: Will the Minister of
HOME AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) the State-wise number of freedom
fighters, as on date;
(b) whether Government are aware of
miserable condition of the families of
freedom fighters;
(c) if so, the details thereof;
(d) whether Government have
formulated any scheme to provide relief to
the families of the freedom fighters; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
Slow industrial growth
*142. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the slow
down in manufacturing, power and mining
sectors has pulled down industrial growth;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor; and
(c) the steps taken to boost these
sectors, for better industrial growth?
FDI in manufacturing
industries
†*143. SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
SHRI RAVI SHANKAR
PRASAD:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government consider
Foreign Direct Investment as essential for
the growth of manufacturing industries in
the country;
(b) if so, the details in this regard and
how much FDI is being assessed to be
needed for this sector in the present
circumstances;
(c) whether Government are formulating
a new scheme to promote foreign direct
investment in the manufacturing industries;
and
(d) if so, the details thereof?

45
Threat to livelihood by FTAs
*144. SHRI SITARAM YECHURY:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Free Trade Agreements
entered into with different nations are
threatening the livelihood of majority of
population in our country;
(b) whether it is a fact that the agreements
entered with Nepal and Sri Lanka are
particularly inimical to the interests of agro-
based industries such as vanaspati; and
(c) if so, the steps being taken by
Government to protect the interests of the
Indian agro-based industries?
Ban on SIMI
*145. SHRI S.S. AHLUWALIA:
SHRI MANGANI LAL
MANDAL:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether a ban has been imposed on
the Students Islamic Movement of India
(SIMI) as unlawful organization;
(b) if so, the details thereof, including
the year-wise details of the number of its
activists taken into custody, prosecuted,
convicted and/or acquitted since imposition
of the ban;
(c) whether, despite the ban the activists
of SIMI have been allowed to carry on its
activities in various States;
(d) if so, the details thereof;
(e) the details as to the nature of alert, if
any, decimated from intelligence agencies
about involvement of SIMI activists in
perpetration of unlawful acts; and
(f) the action taken in the light thereof?
Unemployment allowance to
Engineering Graduates
*146. SHRI RAJEEV SHUKLA: Will
the Minister of LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether National Technical
Manpower Information System has made
any survey in the recent past to know the
unemployment rate of engineering graduates
in the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the steps taken to provide them
employment; and
(d) whether there is any proposal to
provide them with unemployment
allowance?
PMGSY in Gujarat
*147. PROF. ALKA BALRAM
KSHATRIYA: W ill the Minister of
RURAL DEVELOPMENT be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that funds for the
Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana
(PMGSY) are given to the States from the
collection of cess levied on diesel;
(b) the amount of such collection from
Gujarat during the last three years; year-wise;
(c) the amount of disbursement to that
State from this fund during the same period,
year-wise; and
(d) whether it is a fact that this
disbursement is not based of tax collection
from diesel consumed in Gujarat?
Employment opportunities
*148. SHRI T.T.V. DHINAKARAN:
Will the Minister of LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government

46
had targeted creation of around five crore
employment opportunities during the Tenth
Five Year Plan period;
(b) if so, the steps taken to achieve the
target; and
(c) the target achieved so far, sector-
wise and State-wise?
Formation of Geographical
Identification Registry
*149. SHRI B.K. HARIPRASAD: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are considering
formation of a Geographical Identification
Registry for the country for region-specific
agro-produce like Darjeeling Tea, Nagpur
Oranges and Coorg Coffee;
(b) if so, the tentative list of products
to be listed in the Registry;
(c) whether rose onion which is
exclusively grown in Central Karnataka,

RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for WRITTEN ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday,  the August 2, 2006/Sravana 11, 1928 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Commerce and Industry; Defence; Home Affairs; Labour and
Employment; Rural Development; Textiles)
Total number of questions — 155
Representation to Bihar in Tea Board
†864. SHRI MANGANI LAL
MANDAL: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that extensive
farming of tea has been undertaken in
Kishanganj district of Bihar during the past
several years;
(b) whether it is also a fact that Bihar
has not been given representation in the
Tea Board by nominating any tea
entrepreneur from that State as a member;
and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Effect of import of edible oils
†865. SHRI LALIT KISHORE
CHATURVEDI: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are importing
edible oils from other countries;
(b) if so, the quantity thereof and the
names of those countries, togetherwith the
rates at which oil is being imported;
(c) whether it would adversely affect
the edible oil business of the country; and
(d) its impact on the producers of
mustard and soyabean?
Production capacity of cement
industry
866. SHRI N.R. GOVINDARAJAR:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the present production capacity of
cement industry in the country;
(b) whether the production of cement
in the country has fallen short of demand
during the last three years;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) the steps taken by Government to
enhance the production capacity of the
cement industry?
Import of coconut oil
867. SHRI A.K. ANTONY: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the quantity of coconut oil imported
in the year 2005-06;
(b) whether Government have received
any representation to stop such imports,
in order to save the coconut growers from
the crashing prices;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

200
(c) whether Government are considering
quantity restrictions on the import of
coconut oil; and
(d) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor?
National network of producers of
agriculture related sectors
868. SHRI A. VIJAYARAGHAVAN:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether there is any proposal to
create a national network of producers, co-
operative bodies in agriculture, horticulture
and other related primary sectors, to market
and export products; and
(b) if so, the details thereof, including
the steps taken and the organizations
associated with the above, as on date?
Comprehensive Economic
Cooperation Agreements
869. SHRI RA VULA CHANDRA
SEKAR REDDY: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have signed
any Comprehensive Economic Cooperation
Agreement with any country;
(b) if so, the details thereof country-
wise; and
(c) the trade reported so far with each
country?
Countries posing threat to Indian
exports
870. DR. M.A.M. RAMASWAMY:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Sri Lanka,
Kenya, Vietnam, Indonesia and Guatemala
have emerged as major threats to Indian
exports;
(b) if so, the total quantum of exports
of Indian tea, pepper and cardamom during
the last three years, vis-a-vis above
countries; and
(c) the steps taken by Government to
boost plantation sector in India?
Decline in export of diamonds and
jewellery
†871. PROF. ALKA BALRAM
KSHATRIYA: W ill the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the export of diamond and
jewellery has been declining for the last
two years;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the reasons ascertained by
Government for such decline; and
(d) the steps taken by Government in
this regard?
Duty exemption schemes for exports
872. SHRI TAPAN KUMAR SEN:
SHRI CHITTABRATA
MAJUMDAR:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the outlines of the existing schemes
involving tax and duty exemptions for
encouraging exports; and
(b) the total amount involved per year
in extending various concessions under the
above schemes?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

201
Setting up of SEZs in Tamil Nadu
873. SHRI T.T.V. DHINAKARAN:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Board of Approval is
considering setting up of Special Economic
Zones (SEZs) at various locations in the
country;
(b) if so, the locations under
consideration in Tamil Nadu; and
(c) the incentive and facilities likely to
be given to the proposed SEZs?
Ban on export of iron-ore
874. DR. M.A.M. RAMASWAMY:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether steel producers and the
Associated Chambers of Commerce and
Industry of India (ASSOCHAM) have
demanded total ban on export of iron-ore;
(b) if so, the details in this regard;
